nodes.label: DJ library import and live sync
nodes.rationale: GLUE reads DJ app libraries from rekordbox, Engine DJ, Serato, Traktor, and Apple Music. With GLUE Home, libraries are followed live; playlists brought into GLUE on demand and stay linked.

nodes.label: Engine DJ cues, loops and grid two-way sync
nodes.rationale: With main Engine DJ library marked, GLUE Home keeps hot cues (pads A-H), saved loops (memory loops), and beat grids in step both ways. Writes only while Engine DJ is closed, after backup. Clashes shown in Prepare tab.

nodes.label: Main DJ library
nodes.rationale: One DJ library per computer designated main. Its beat grids and cues become every song's by default. GLUE Home syncs with it both ways when Keep in step is enabled.

nodes.label: GLUE playlists in Engine DJ GLUE folder
nodes.rationale: GLUE's own playlists can be kept in Engine DJ's GLUE folder both ways. DJ app playlists stay in their app's collection. Songs Engine DJ lacks are added to its collection; ones that can't go stay in GLUE's list.

nodes.label: Songs with no file linked
nodes.rationale: DJ library records whose files are gone are matched to library songs on No file linked page with certainty scores and linked in bulk. Linked songs take playlists and prepared info from the missing records.
